ld.title: Launch default
ld.sub: Save the whole shop look and bring it back in one step — useful after a festival.
ld.note: A look holds the page layouts, your own sections, each category's own order, the side canvas, the light sweeps and which house ads are on. Restoring never deletes anything and never changes a price, an offer, a delivery charge or Cash on Delivery.
ld.readOnly: You can see this page. Saving or restoring a look needs the permission to change page layouts.
ld.seasonLive: A seasonal home look (Marketing › Seasonal home) is showing on the home page now. It is not part of a saved look: it stays until its window ends or you stop it there.

launch.title: Launch default
launch.sub: The look the shop opened with. "Back to launch default" returns the whole look to it at any time.
launch.none: No launch default yet. On launch day, press "Save this look as the launch default".
launch.save: Save this look as the launch default

looks.title: Saved looks
looks.sub: Looks you saved by name (for example "Eid 2027"), and the looks saved by themselves just before each restore.
looks.save: Save the look as it is now

log.title: Restore log
log.sub: Every restore and undo, newest first. The newest one can be undone.

auto.edit: Published on the shop page (on-page edit)

ask.launchTitle: Go back to the launch default “{name}”?
ask.saveTitle: Save the look as it is now
ask.saveLaunchTitle: Save this look as the launch default
ask.first: The look as it is now is saved first, so you can undo this.
ask.kept: Sections, side zones, category orders and house ads made since are kept, switched off. Nothing is deleted.
ask.tests: The {n} running A/B tests are paused (kept; Undo lets them run again).
ask.money: Prices, offers, delivery charges and Cash on Delivery do not change.
ask.undoBack: The shop's look goes back to how it was just before that restore.
ask.saveNote: Saves the page layouts, your sections, the side canvas, the light sweeps and which house ads are on. Nothing on the shop changes.
ask.saveLaunchNote: This becomes the launch default. An earlier launch default stays in Saved looks. Nothing on the shop changes.
ask.name: Name

keys.title: What a look holds
keys.sub: These parts of the shop are saved in a look and brought back by a restore:

k.home_sections: Home page sections, their order and screens
k.layout_blocks: Your own sections (banners, rows, tiles, text …)
k.layout_sideCanvas: The side canvas switch and its numbers

keys.ads: Which house ads and their places are switched on
keys.not: Not part of a look: words, eye-toggles, the announcement bar, the flash sale, the bag and checkout, prices, offers, delivery and payments.

err.STALE: The shop's look changed meanwhile. The page was reloaded; try again.
err.NO_LAUNCH_DEFAULT: There is no launch default yet.
err.NOT_ALLOWED: This step is not possible any more. The page was reloaded.
err.not-found: That look is not there any more.
err.forbidden: You do not have the permission for this.
err.network: No connection. Nothing changed; try again.
err.other: Could not do that. Nothing changed; try again.

page.title: Snapshots of this page
page.sub: Keep this page as it is now under a name, and bring it back later. Only this page changes; the whole shop look is under Website › Launch default.
page.none: No snapshots of this page yet.

ask.saveTitle: Save this page as a snapshot
ask.saveNote: What is saved now on this page is kept. Changes you have not saved yet are not in it.
ask.name: Name
ask.first: This page as it is now is saved first (“Before restoring …”), so you can bring it back.
ask.kept: Sections and zones made since stay, switched off. Nothing is deleted.
ask.draft: Changes on this page that are not saved yet are lost.
ask.money: Prices, offers, delivery charges and Cash on Delivery never change.

err.STALE: This page changed meanwhile. It was reloaded; try again.
err.INVALID_INPUT: That did not fit this page. Nothing changed.
err.not-found: That snapshot is not there any more.
err.forbidden: You do not have the permission for this.
err.network: No connection. Nothing changed; try again.
err.other: Could not do that. Nothing changed; try again.
